entries.text: Fixed QuestDB queries using GROUP BY ROLLUP, CUBE or GROUPING SETS (and GROUPING()) failing with "column must appear in GROUP BY clause or aggregate function" (TPC-DS Q5, Q18, Q22, Q27, Q36, Q67, Q77, Q80, Q86 and the OLAP rollup/cube primitives); QuestDB has no grouping sets, so the adapter now expands them into one UNION ALL level per grouping set.
